name: disclosure-accounts
title: Disclosure accounts
description: Published financial statements and notes: fixed layouts with headings, subtotals and totals, this year against last year, rounded, negatives in brackets — laid out for printing or PDF. Numbers read live from TM1.

settings.heading: The screen title
settings.subtitle: One line under it
settings.entity: The company name printed at the top
settings.period: e.g. For the year ended 31 December
settings.where: { dimension: member } — the slice (version, currency, period…)
settings.lineDimension: The dimension the statement lines come from (e.g. Account)
settings.columns: [{ label, at: { dimension: member } }] — e.g. this year and last year; every column uses the same dimensions
settings.statements: [{ title, lines: [{ label, member, style: heading | line | subtotal | total, sign: -1 | 1, note }] }] — no member = a heading
settings.notes: [{ number, title, text }] — notes to the accounts

example.heading: Annual accounts
example.subtitle: Draft — numbers read live from TM1
example.period: For the year ended 31 December, Year 2 (comparative: prior year)

notes.title: Basis of preparation
notes.text: These statements are prepared from the planning model. They are a draft and have not been audited.

notes.title: Revenue
notes.text: Revenue is recognised when goods are sold to customers.

notes.title: Employee costs
notes.text: Includes salaries, benefits and payroll taxes.
